about: Intermittent test failures: first seen, evidence, classification (PRODUCT / HARNESS / ENVIRONMENT / UNEXPLAINED) and status (OPEN INTERMITTENT / EXPLAINED / FIXED). A failure is never marked FIXED without a reproduced cause. Never delete an entry.

entries.cause: 200 simultaneous psql callers against max_connections=100; refused callers ('too many clients already') were ignored, so their +1 never ran (1190 of 1200). The database lost nothing.
entries.reproduced: locally with max_connections=30: old harness 4 failures, new harness 98/98 (25 refusals retried)
entries.fix: 3980d99: retry only connection refusals (before the session starts, so nothing can apply twice); refusal count reported
entries.evidenceAfterFix: GitHub database job green on 3980d99, f2b2d33 (x2)

entries.test: tests/specs/chaos-ui-ext15.spec.js › offline: the offline bar never covers the menu button, Refresh or Sign out (desktop)
entries.cause: The desktop test resizes 1100 -> 760 px, crossing the 820 px breakpoint; the sidebar then slides away with a 0.22 s transform. A check inside that slide finds the sidebar (its search box) over the menu button. The offline bar is not involved. Not a product bug: the drawer is meant to slide away when the window narrows.
entries.reproduced: tests/forensics/offline-bar.probe.spec.js: first-instant check without waiting for animations 64/150 covered (quiet) and 3/50 (CPU load, 4 workers); after waiting for running animations 0/50 (quiet) and 0/50 (CPU load, 4 workers)
entries.fix: EXT16: the test waits for running animations after the resize, then checks strictly at the first instant (the 5 s re-check added in EXT15 is removed)

entries.test: tests/specs/chaos-ui-ext15.spec.js › chaos shrinker on the real runner (one replay of a shortened sequence)
entries.cause: page.waitForLoadState('networkidle') did not settle within 30 s at step 2 of one replayed 3-step sequence (task button flow). Not seen in any full chaos run (3 seeds desktop + phone pass). Possibly a request left pending by the mock's delayNext across a replay reset; not established.
entries.fix: none yet; the 30 s action limit (EXT16) turns any recurrence into a named failure instead of a stall

entries.test: DB suite: docs/ops/sql/local-test/stress_test.sh › S29 no deadlock (delete product vs delivery)

firstSeen.where: GitHub CI database job, stress run 3 of 5

lastSeen.where: GitHub CI database job, stress run 3 of 5

entries.cause: Lock-order cycle in the DRAFT function delete_unused_product (drafts/10, not installed anywhere): its 'in use?' checks run before it locks the product, so a delivery line committed in that instant is missed. The receive then holds the line and waits for the product; the delete holds the product and its foreign-key check waits for the line. PostgreSQL cancels one call and rolls it back: no data damage (the S29 consistency check passed). Only reachable when a line is added, the product deleted and the order received at the same moment.
entries.reproduced: deterministically: docs/ops/sql/local-test/s29_lock_cycle_repro.sh prints DEADLOCK every run (2 of 2); server log: receive waits for the product (key share), delete waits for the receive's transaction. Random S29 alone: 0 in 40 quiet rounds (timing-dependent).
entries.fix: not applied in EXT16 (changes the reviewed R1-R5 fingerprint used in ~25 files, including read-only Query H). Proposed for EXT17: repeat the in-use checks right after locking the product. Prototype on a throwaway database: repro 3 of 3 without deadlock (delete answers in_use, receive succeeds). Until then S29 can fail rarely on GitHub.

entries.test: tests/specs/mutation-runner-ext14.spec.js › Ctrl-C during a mutant removes the worktree and leaves the real tree untouched
entries.cause: Not timing: the test interrupts one named mutant, whose text EXT16 had replaced (PO receive state machine). A mutant that no longer applies leaves its worktree for milliseconds, so the test's wait for it ran out. The same check found 17 of 187 mutants no longer applicable (14 manual-order mutants after EXT16 moved that page's script into assets/manual-order-entry.js, 2 PO receive mutants, 1 agents mutant stale since EXT15); only subsets had been run, so nothing failed loudly.
entries.reproduced: node tests/mutation/run-page-mutations.js --check: 17 not applicable before the fix, 0 after
entries.fix: EXT16: 17 mutants retargeted (all 18 matching mutants CAUGHT on a real run); runner --check mode plus a test that every mutant applies exactly once; the order pages' ?v= fingerprints are refreshed inside mutant worktrees
